title: 第二十一章 离凡入修初踏长路第二十二章 位面通道初入修真界
content_zh:
三日后。
小院院门缓缓开启。
烬孤宸一身粗布麻衣，背负简单行囊，手中紧攥那枚高位面玉佩，踏出了居住月余的院落。
经过三日闭关苦修，他的筑基初期境界已然彻底圆满，道台凝实无瑕，肉身经由《寂骨锻体诀》千锤百炼，同阶之内再无对手。低等凡俗世界的天地灵气、规则上限，已然无法再给他带来丝毫提升。
继续滞留此地，只是空耗光阴。
他的目标很明确：离开青岚镇，走出这片南疆大地，前往整片低等凡俗世界的灵气汇聚之地——万莽山脉深处。
那里残存上古修士遗迹，留有正统修真传承，是踏入中千修真世界的必经之路。
整条长街上，行人见他现身，纷纷避让。昔日碾压宗门长老的战绩，早已传遍四方，无人敢与之对视。
烬孤宸视若无睹，脚步沉稳，一路向北，径直走出青岚镇南门。
前路漫漫，山野连绵，荒林密布。
低等凡俗世界灵气枯竭，野兽横行，偶尔还有穷凶极恶的江湖匪类、亡命之徒出没。但这些，对于早已历经无数生死绝境的烬孤宸而言，构不成半点威胁。
他一路独行，昼夜兼程。白日吸纳天地间微薄灵气，运转功法打磨肉身与道基；夜间就地打坐，推演五行大道的基础纹路，感悟天地间最原始的法则轨迹。
《寂骨锻体诀》本就是绝境炼体的残缺古诀，越在艰苦环境中，淬炼效果越强。荒林的瘴气、猛兽的利爪、山路的崎岖，皆成了他磨砺道心与肉身的资粮。
他从不行走捷径，不寻机缘，不贪宝物。心性孤冷，万物皆为试炼，唯有大道为终极追求。
半月之后，无尽荒林尽头，万莽山脉赫然在望。
这座横亘数万里的巨型山脉，是低等凡俗世界的灵脉核心。灵气浓度远超外界数倍，山林深处遗留着上古修士陨落之后的洞府、功法残卷、灵草奇石，也是整片世界，唯一能孕育出金丹强者的区域。
山脉外围，已然聚集了四方江湖武者、散修、小型宗门弟子。人人怀揣机缘之梦，涌入山林寻宝、求道。
人声嘈杂，利益交织，纷争四起。
“前方发现一处废弃洞府！快走！”
“别抢！此地是我们黑风寨先发现的！”

“区区江湖匪类，也敢觊觎修士传承？找死！”
冲突、厮杀、掠夺，每时每刻都在山林边缘上演。弱肉强食，在这里被演绎得淋漓尽致。
烬孤宸穿行在人群之中，面色淡漠，目不斜视。
周遭的争斗、宝物、机缘，皆不入他眼。他所求的，从来不是一时的功法与宝物，而是一条可以直通中千修真世界的完整修行路。
他目光扫过整座万莽山脉，神念铺开。筑基境界的神念，在这片凡俗天地中足以横扫四方。很快，他锁定了山脉最深处，一处灵气最为浓郁、天地规则隐隐异变的山谷。
那里，有上古修士留下的完整传承道统。
没有片刻停留，他纵身而起，踏入万莽山脉深处。
越是深入山林，灵气越是充沛，妖兽的实力也越发强悍。数丈高的巨熊、速度如风的青纹猎豹、剧毒缠身的灵蛇，层出不穷。这些妖兽，早已吸纳灵气蜕变，实力远超寻常野兽，部分甚至达到凝劲、通脉层次。
遇到拦路妖兽，烬孤宸从不多言。抬手之间，灵气凝于掌间，或是肉身直接碰撞。
砰！
一头达到凝劲境界的铁甲巨熊咆哮着扑来，熊掌带着千斤巨力拍向他头颅。
烬孤宸侧身闪避，右拳裹挟筑基灵气与千锤百炼的肉身之力，轰然砸在熊首之上。
一声闷响，巨熊庞大的身躯轰然倒地，瞬间气绝。
出手干脆利落，杀伐毫不拖泥带水。他共情全无，生灵阻拦前路，便直接抹去，心中没有半分怜悯。
一路横推，妖兽尽皆伏诛。他不剥取妖皮、不取妖丹，击杀之后便继续前行，丝毫不停留。
外界修士听闻深处妖兽凶悍，不敢深入，唯有他，孤身直闯，如入无人之境。
content_en:
Three days later.
The door of the small courtyard slowly opened.
Jin Guchen was dressed in coarse linen clothes, carrying a simple bag on his back, holding the high-level jade pendant tightly in his hand, and stepped out of the courtyard where he had lived for more than a month.
After three days of seclusion and hard training, his initial stage of foundation building has been completely perfected. The Taoist platform is solid and flawless, and his body has been tempered countless times by the "Silent Bone Body Forging Technique". There is no opponent at the same level. The aura of heaven and earth and the upper limit of rules in the lower mortal world can no longer bring him the slightest improvement.
Continuing to stay here is just a waste of time.
His goal is clear: to leave Qinglan Town, go out of this southern land, and go to the place where the spiritual energy of the entire lower mortal world gathers - deep in the Wanmang Mountains.
There are remnants of ancient monks and orthodox cultivation inheritance, which is the only way to enter the world of Zhongqian cultivation.
On the whole long street, pedestrians saw his appearance and gave way. The record of crushing the elders of the sect in the past has been spread all over the world, and no one dares to look at it.
Jin Guchen turned a blind eye and walked steadily, heading north all the way out of the south gate of Qinglan Town.
The road ahead is long, with rolling mountains and wild forests.
The spiritual energy of the lower mortal world is exhausted, wild beasts are rampant, and occasionally vicious gangsters and desperadoes appear. But these do not constitute the slightest threat to Jin Guchen, who has already experienced countless desperate situations of life and death.
He traveled alone, day and night. During the day, you absorb the meager spiritual energy between heaven and earth, and use the exercises to polish your physical body and Tao foundation; at night, you meditate on the spot, deduce the basic patterns of the Five Elements Avenue, and understand the most primitive laws and tracks between heaven and earth.
"Silent Bone Body Training Technique" is an incomplete ancient technique for body training in desperate situations. The more difficult the environment, the stronger the tempering effect. The miasma of the wild forest, the sharp claws of wild beasts, and the rugged mountain roads all became the materials for him to sharpen his Taoist mind and body.
He never takes shortcuts, doesn't look for opportunities, and doesn't covet treasures. With a lonely and cold mind, everything is a trial, and only the great road is the ultimate pursuit.
Half a month later, at the end of the endless forest, the vast mountains are clearly visible.
This giant mountain range spanning tens of thousands of miles is the spiritual core of the lower mortal world. The concentration of spiritual energy is many times higher than that of the outside world. Deep in the mountains and forests, there are caves, residual scrolls of exercises, spiritual grass and strange stones left after the death of ancient monks. It is also the only area in the entire world that can breed powerful people with golden elixirs.
On the outskirts of the mountain range, warriors, casual cultivators, and small sect disciples from all directions have gathered. With the dream of opportunity, everyone rushes into the mountains and forests to search for treasure and seek enlightenment.
People are noisy, interests are intertwined, and disputes are everywhere.
"We found an abandoned cave ahead! Let's go!"
"Don't grab it! Our Black Wind Village discovered this place first!"
"A mere gangster dares to covet the inheritance of a monk? He is seeking death!"
Conflicts, fighting, and plundering take place every moment on the edge of the mountains and forests. The law of the jungle is vividly demonstrated here.
Jin Guchen walked through the crowd, his expression indifferent and his eyes not squinting.
The battles, treasures, and opportunities around him are all indifferent to him. What he seeks is never temporary skills and treasures, but a complete path of cultivation that can lead directly to the world of Zhongqian cultivation.
His gaze swept across the entire vast mountain range, and his spiritual thoughts spread out. The spiritual thoughts in the foundation-building realm are enough to sweep across all directions in this mortal world. Soon, he locked onto the deepest part of the mountain range, a valley with the richest aura and subtle changes in the rules of heaven and earth.
There, there is a complete inheritance left by the ancient monks.
Without stopping for a moment, he jumped up and stepped into the depths of the Wanmang Mountains.
The deeper you go into the mountains and forests, the more spiritual energy becomes abundant, and the monsters become more powerful. Giant bears that are several feet tall, blue-striped cheetahs that are as fast as the wind, and poisonous snakes appear one after another. These monsters have already absorbed spiritual energy and transformed, and their strength far exceeds that of ordinary beasts, and some even reach the level of condensing energy and channeling.
Jin Guchen never said much when encountering monsters blocking his way. When you raise your hands, spiritual energy condenses in your palms, or your physical body collides directly.
Bang!
An armored giant bear that has reached the state of concentration roars.He rushed towards him and slapped his head with the huge force of the bear's paw.
Jin Guchen dodged sideways, and with his right fist wrapped in the foundation-building spiritual energy and the strength of his body that had been tempered for thousands of years, he slammed into the bear's head.
With a muffled sound, the giant bear's huge body fell to the ground and died instantly.
The attack is crisp and clear, and the killing is not sloppy. He has no empathy at all. If the creatures block his path, he simply wipes them away without any mercy in his heart.
Pushing all the way, all the monsters will be killed. He did not peel off the demon's skin or take the demon's elixir. After killing it, he continued to move forward without stopping at all.
The outside monks heard that the monsters in the depths were ferocious and did not dare to go deep. He was the only one who went straight in alone, as if he was entering a deserted place.
